case.summary: The alert concerns a single $292.36 online purchase that, while the customer’s largest to date, still fits their exclusive online spending pattern. There is no burst of transactions, no new device or email, and no mismatched identity flags, so none of the defined fraud patterns cleanly apply. A prior fraud case on this card raises some residual concern, but evidence for current compromise is weak. Overall likelihood of fraud is moderate (≈45%), so verification with the customer would be prudent before any block.
